answer: A wireless AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via RF fingerprinting and multi-gateway localization. As an agent on a rooftop terrace answers signed challenges, verifiers sample raw waveforms to extract the unique frequency offset of its quartz crystal oscillator and triangulate its position, rejecting co-located or matching signals. Attackers must deploy separate radios at distinct sites per identity. Yet temperature swings shift crystal resonance and cause false rejections.
